```{r}
#set_wd to sourcefile location

PSMs_2_read <- list.files("input/txt_exports",
                          # "input/PD/2025_08_Steph_TMTpro_PSMs_MSstatsTMT_EEvsSH_for_PhD/txt_exports",
                          # pattern = "(F3|F7).*PSM.*\\.txt$",  # pattern PSM & ends .txt
                          pattern = ".*PSM.*\\.txt$",  # pattern PSM & ends .txt
                          full.names = TRUE, # gets full names including path,
                          recursive = TRUE)

PD_PSMs_raw <- read_tsv(PSMs_2_read, # read all files from list above
                    id = "file_path") # keep file path as an id column
```


```{r}
unique(PD_PSMs_raw$file_path)
colnames(PD_PSMs_raw)
str(PD_PSMs_raw)

PD_PSMs <- PD_PSMs_raw %>%
  separate_wider_delim(file_path, # splits file path into folder variables
                       delim = "/",
                       names = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, "extra", "details", "file_name"),
                       too_few = "align_end") %>%
  
  mutate(extra = if_else(extra == "extra", extra, NA)) %>% # rm extra non dets
  mutate(details = if_else(details == "txt_exports", NA, details))
```

```{r}
PD_PSMs_details <- PD_PSMs %>%
  select(file_name,extra,details, `Spectrum File`) %>%
  unique() 
```

```{r}
combined_anno <-  left_join(PD_PSMs_details, raw_anno,
                            by = join_by(`Spectrum File` == Run)) 
```

```{r}
PD_PSMs_pipette <- PD_PSMs %>%
  filter(!grepl("TR1_|TR2_", file_name))  %>% # 16 files | keeps only F3 
  mutate(HpHF = case_when( # add fraciton row
    str_detect(file_name, "_F3") ~ "F3",
    str_detect(file_name, "_F7") ~ "F7",
    .default = NA)) %>%
  mutate(PoolRef = if_else(str_detect(file_name, "FP_"), "FP", "MP")) %>%
  mutate(RunYear = case_when( # add fraciton row
    str_detect(file_name, "DEC2021_") ~ "2021",
    str_detect(file_name, "NOV2022_") ~ "2022",
    .default = NA)) %>%
  mutate(Batch = case_when( # add fraciton row
    str_detect(file_name, "B1_") ~ "B1",
    str_detect(file_name, "B2_") ~ "B2",
    str_detect(file_name, "B3_") ~ "B3",
    str_detect(file_name, "B4_") ~ "B4",
    .default = NA)) %>%
  filter(!grepl("gradient_check", file_name)) # actually rm gradient check one | now 12

unique(PD_PSMs_pipette$file_name)
unique(PD_PSMs_pipette$`File ID`)

PD_PSMs_pipette_gg <- PD_PSMs_pipette %>%
  group_by(file_name) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Abundance"), # cols 2 pivot
               names_to = "TMT_tag", # names column
               names_prefix = "Abundance ", # recognise prefix
               values_to = "Abundance")  # new values col


PD_PSMs_pipette_gg$TMT_tag <- factor(PD_PSMs_pipette_gg$TMT_tag,
                                     levels = c('126', '127N', '127C', '128N',
                                                '128C', '129N', '129C', '130N',
                                                '130C', '131N', '131C', '132N',
                                                '132C', '133N', '133C', '134N'))

PD_PSMs_pipette_gg$PoolRef <- factor(PD_PSMs_pipette_gg$PoolRef,
                                     levels = c("MP", "FP"))

```

```{r}
PD_PSMs_pipette_gg_plot <- ggplot(PD_PSMs_pipette_gg,
                                  aes(x=TMT_tag, y = Abundance, fill = PoolRef,
                                      color = RunYear)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.95,
    outlier.shape = 1,outlier.size = .5, outlier.alpha = 0.03) +
  facet_grid(~RunYear+PoolRef+Batch)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#d9d9d9", "#fddaec")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#384e8a", "#a8405e")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2000), expand = expansion(mult = 0.03)) + # 1%
  # labs(title = "Pipette Tips & Pipetting Errors!",
  #      subtitle = "Raw abundance values across TMT channels by Batch/Year (& Pooled Reference)")+
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size =7),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "grey10",linewidth = 0.3), #plot bord
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
        panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
        strip.background = element_rect(color = 'grey10',
                                        fill = 'grey91',linewidth = .2),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9, color = "grey10",
                                  margin = margin(b = 1, t = 1)),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .1, colour = "grey15"),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "grey10",, size = 9),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.15),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.15),
         panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"), #
  ) 


PD_PSMs_pipette_gg_plot 
```

```{r}
#set_wd to sourcefile location

PD_resuts_stats_2_read <- list.files("input/txt_exports",

                                     # pattern = "(F3|F7).*ResultsS.*\\.txt$",  # pattern PSM & ends .txt

```


```{r}
PD_results_stats_df <- PD_results_stats_raw %>%
  separate_wider_delim(file_path, # splits file path into folder variables
                       delim = "/",
                       names = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, "extra", "details", "file_name"),
                       too_few = "align_end") %>%
  
  mutate(extra = if_else(extra == "extra", extra, NA)) %>% # rm extra non dets
  mutate(details = if_else(details == "txt_exports", NA, details)) 
  
```

```{r}
PD_results_stats_df_F3_F7 <- PD_results_stats_df %>%
  filter(!grepl("TR1_|TR2_", file_name))  %>% # 16 files | keeps only F3 
  mutate(HpHF = case_when( # add fraciton row
    str_detect(file_name, "_F3") ~ "F3",
    str_detect(file_name, "_F7") ~ "F7",
    .default = NA)) %>%
  mutate(PoolRef = if_else(str_detect(file_name, "FP_"), "FP", "MP")) %>%
  mutate(RunYear = case_when( # add fraciton row
    str_detect(file_name, "DEC2021_") ~ "2021",
    str_detect(file_name, "NOV2022_") ~ "2022",
    .default = NA)) %>%
  mutate(Batch = case_when( # add fraciton row
    str_detect(file_name, "B1_") ~ "B1",
    str_detect(file_name, "B2_") ~ "B2",
    str_detect(file_name, "B3_") ~ "B3",
    str_detect(file_name, "B4_") ~ "B4",
    .default = NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HpHF)) # 7232
  # filter(!grepl("gradient_check", file_name))  # actually rm gradient check one | now 12
```

```{r}
PD_results_stats_df_F3_F7_global <- PD_results_stats_df_F3_F7 %>% #
  filter(!str_detect(Name, regex("Abundance|Decoy", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>% #2624
  separate_wider_delim(Name, # splits file path into folder variables
                       delim = " -",
                       # names = c("PD_stat_tab", "test"),
                       names = c("PD_stat_tab"),
                       too_many = "drop") %>%
  group_by(file_name, PD_stat_tab) %>%
  slice_head(n=1)

#unique(PD_results_stats_df_F3_F7_global$file_name)
```

```{r}
PD_results_stats_df_F3_F7_global_wide <- PD_results_stats_df_F3_F7_global %>%
  select(extra:file_name, PD_stat_tab, Count, HpHF:Batch ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = PD_stat_tab, values_from = Count) %>%
  mutate(trm_name = gsub("2025_08_Steph_TMTpro-16plex_|_ResultStatistics.txt",
                         "", file_name,), .after = file_name) %>%
  mutate(PSM2MS2 = round(((PSMs/`MS/MS Spectrum Info`)*100),2)) %>%
  arrange(RunYear, PoolRef) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(!file_name) %>%
  gt()

PD_results_stats_df_F3_F7_global_wide

```
